title_en: Hongqiao District People's Procuratorate of Tianjin v. Li Huanqiang — intentional destruction of property case

full_text_en:
Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Procuratorate v. Li Huanqiang — dispute over intentional destruction of property

Ruling Summary

I. According to Article 12, Item (4) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Theft Cases, where an actor, without the intent to unlawfully appropriate public or private property, steals and drives a motor vehicle for other purposes, thereby causing damage to the vehicle, the actor shall be convicted and punished for the crime of intentional destruction of property in accordance with Article 275 of the Criminal Law.

II. Where an actor steals and drives another person's motor vehicle from a parking lot, causing damage to the vehicle, thus constituting the crime of intentional destruction of property, although a vehicle custody contract relationship exists between the entity operating the parking lot and the vehicle owner, that entity is not a party legally obligated to bear criminal supplementary civil compensation liability. The contractual dispute between the entity and the vehicle owner and the criminal supplementary civil compensation liability arising from the criminal act are different legal relationships. Where the vehicle owner names that entity as a defendant in the criminal supplementary civil action and claims that the entity shall bear joint and several liability for the criminal supplementary civil compensation liability that the perpetrator ought to bear, such claim shall not be supported according to law.

III. According to Articles 1 and 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Scope of Criminal Supplementary Civil Actions, where a person suffers material losses due to infringement of personal rights by a criminal offense, or suffers material losses because property is destroyed by a criminal, a criminal supplementary civil action may be initiated. The material losses suffered by the victim due to the criminal act refer to the actual losses already suffered and the losses that will inevitably be suffered by the victim as a result of the criminal act. Accordingly, the scope of criminal supplementary civil compensation shall be limited to the direct economic losses suffered by the victim as a result of the criminal act.

Prosecutorial Authority: Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Procuratorate.

Defendant and Criminal Supplementary Civil Action Defendant: Li Huanqiang, male, 46 years old, Han ethnicity, unemployed, no fixed residence. In 1984, was sentenced to one year and six months of fixed-term imprisonment for the crime of theft. Was arrested on March 31, 2006 in connection with this case.

Criminal Supplementary Civil Action Plaintiff: Li Cheng, male, 51 years old, Han ethnicity, residing at Yichang Road, Heping District, Tianjin, engaged in individual transportation business.

Criminal Supplementary Civil Action Defendant: Hongqiao Branch of Tianjin Public Security Bureau, domiciled at Xinchun Street, Hongqiao District, Tianjin.

Legal Representative: Liu Kejian, Director of this Branch Bureau.

The Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Procuratorate initiated a public prosecution against the defendant Li Huanqiang for the crime of intentional destruction of property, filing the case with the Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Court. During the proceedings, the victim Li Cheng filed a criminal supplementary civil action with the Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Court, naming Li Huanqiang and the Hongqiao Branch of Tianjin Public Security Bureau (hereinafter referred to as the Public Security Hongqiao Branch) as defendants.

The Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Procuratorate alleged: At around 22:00 on November 24, 2004, the defendant Li Huanqiang, carrying a car key for his former employer that he had not returned, went to the Fuyuan Building parking lot on No. 1 Road, Dingzigu, Hongqiao District. Taking advantage of the parking lot staff's inattention, he drove away a "North China" brand HC6790 type minibus with the license plate Jin-A84941, which belonged to his former employer and was parked in that lot. At around 20:00 on November 25, 2004, while driving the vehicle, Li Huanqiang had an accident near Building 57, Xiangyang Lou, Hongxing Road, Hedong District, colliding with a roadside utility pole and damaging the vehicle. Li Huanqiang abandoned the minibus near Building 1, Tianchi Li, Chenyang Road, Hedong District, and then fled. After the vehicle owner reported the case, police investigation led to the discovery of the involved vehicle on December 1, 2004. At that time, the "Xiamhua" brand in-vehicle TV and multi-disc VCD player installed inside the vehicle had been stolen. According to an appraisal by the Tianjin Hongqiao District Price Certification Center, the damage to the vehicle was valued at RMB 12,433, and the stolen in-vehicle TV and multi-disc VCD player were valued at RMB 2,250. The prosecutorial authority alleged that Li Huanqiang's above acts violated Article 275 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law), constituting the crime of intentional destruction of property, and criminal liability should be pursued according to law.

The Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Procuratorate submitted the following evidence:

1.  Source of the case and certificate of arrest, used to prove the circumstances of the case's initiation and resolution.
2.  Statement of the victim Li Cheng, the main content being: The deponent is engaged in individual passenger transport business. Because he was recruiting a bus driver, he met the defendant Li Huanqiang on October 11, 2004, through the "Qianghui" Employment Agency, and verbally agreed to employ Li Huanqiang as a bus driver. Subsequently, the deponent signed a formal employment agreement with Lin Shuchen and notified Li Huanqiang that he would no longer be employed as a driver. On November 2, 2004, Lin Shuchen discovered that the "North China" brand HC6790 type minibus with license plate Jin-A84941, which he was driving, was missing. Because Li Huanqiang had not returned the car key, Lin Shuchen contacted Li Huanqiang, confirmed that Li Huanqiang had driven the car away, and later retrieved the car without reporting it to the police at that time. At around 6:00 on November 25, 2004, the deponent learned that the minibus had been lost again and contacted Li Huanqiang, but Li Huanqiang's mobile phone was already turned off. Lin Shuchen later reported the case to the police, who found the vehicle. It was discovered that the vehicle was damaged and some of the in-vehicle audio-visual equipment had been stolen.
3.  Testimony of witness Lin Shuchen, the main content consistent with the statement of the victim Li Cheng.
4.  Testimony of witnesses Zhang Qingshan and Zhang Wencai, the main content being: The two witnesses are parking attendants at the Fuyuan Building parking lot on No. 1 Road, Dingzigu, under the Vehicle Management Station of the Public Security Hongqiao Branch. The white medium-sized bus with license plate Jin-A84941, driven by driver Lin Shuchen, had been parked in this lot. In the morning of November 2, 2004, when Lin Shuchen came to retrieve the vehicle, he found it missing. He said it might have been driven away by another driver who worked with him. After confirming this by phone call, the vehicle was driven back that afternoon. At around 3:30 on November 25, 2004, Zhang Qingshan discovered the vehicle missing again. When Lin Shuchen came to retrieve the vehicle at around 6:00 that morning, it was not there. After making some phone calls, he reported the case to the police.
5.  Testimony of witnesses Song Rui, Li Wantong, and Gao Dianzhong, confirming that around the end of November 2004, a blue and white medium-sized bus was parked beside Building 1, Tianchi Li, Hedong District, and the vehicle was partially damaged.
6.  Photographs of physical evidence, used to prove the damaged condition of the involved vehicle.
7.  Price appraisal conclusion issued by the Tianjin Hongqiao District Price Certification Center, used to prove the value of the damage to the involved vehicle and the value of the stolen in-vehicle audio-visual equipment, totaling RMB 14,683.
8.  Identity certificate of the defendant Li Huanqiang and his criminal record materials.

The criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng alleged: The defendant and criminal supplementary civil action defendant Li Huanqiang collided with and damaged the involved vehicle after stealing and driving it away. The parking lot subordinate to the criminal supplementary civil action defendant, the Public Security Hongqiao Branch, failed to fulfill its custody obligation, causing economic losses to the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff. Li Cheng requested Li Huanqiang to compensate for various losses totaling RMB 423,646, with the Public Security Hongqiao Branch bearing joint and several liability.

The criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng submitted the following evidence:

1.  A written document from the Tianjin Beichen District Zhonghua Automobile Repair Factory, proving that the factory had repaired a "North China" brand large bus with license plate Jin-A84941, sent by the Public Security Hongqiao Branch, from December 3, 2004, to the end of January 2005.
2.  Relevant written documents, used to prove the losses suffered by Li Cheng due to this case, including liquidated damages, deposits incurred due to inability to perform passenger transport contracts with others, and losses such as unpaid matured loans.

The defendant and criminal supplementary civil action defendant Li Huanqiang confessed to the facts alleged by the prosecutorial authority and agreed to compensate the losses claimed by the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng, but stated that he currently had no ability to pay compensation.

The criminal supplementary civil action defendant, the Public Security Hongqiao Branch, argued: The economic losses of the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng were caused by the criminal acts of the defendant Li Huanqiang. Li Huanqiang should bear the criminal supplementary civil compensation liability. The Public Security Hongqiao Branch was unrelated to this case and should not bear any liability.

The Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Court found through trial:

The criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng is engaged in individual passenger transport business and is the owner of the "North China" brand HC6790 type minibus with license plate Jin-A84941. The defendant and criminal supplementary civil action defendant Li Huanqiang met Li Cheng in October 2004 through an employment agency, and they verbally agreed that Li Huanqiang would serve as Li Cheng's bus driver. Subsequently, Li Cheng indicated that he would no longer employ Li Huanqiang. Li Huanqiang was dissatisfied with this and harbored a grudge, intending to seize an opportunity to retaliate against Li Cheng. On the evening of November 24, 2004, Li Huanqiang went to the parking lot subordinate to the Public Security Hongqiao Branch located near Fuyuan Lou, No. 1 Road, Dingzigu, Hongqiao District. Taking advantage of the staff's inattention and using the car key he had not returned, he drove away Li Cheng's Jin-A84941 minibus parked there. At around 20:00 the next day, while driving the vehicle near Building 57, Xiangyang Lou, Hongxing Road, Hedong District, Li Huanqiang collided with a roadside utility pole, resulting in damage to the vehicle. Li Huanqiang abandoned the minibus near Building 1, Tianchi Li, Chenyang Road, Hedong District, and then fled. Through investigation, the public security authorities found the vehicle on December 1, 2004. At that time, one "Xiamhua" brand in-vehicle TV and one multi-disc VCD player inside the vehicle had been lost. According to an appraisal by the Tianjin Hongqiao District Price Certification Center, the damage to the vehicle was valued at RMB 12,433, and the stolen in-vehicle TV and VCD player were valued at RMB 2,250. On February 15, 2005, Li Huanqiang was apprehended.

The core issues in this case are: 1. Whether the defendant Li Huanqiang's act constitutes the crime of theft or the crime of intentional destruction of property; 2. Whether the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng's naming of Li Huanqiang and the Public Security Hongqiao Branch as defendants in the criminal supplementary civil action, and his claim that the Public Security Hongqiao Branch should bear joint and several liability for Li Huanqiang's criminal supplementary civil compensation liability, should be supported; 3. How to determine the scope of criminal supplementary civil compensation in this case.

The Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Court held:

The facts alleged in the indictment are sufficient to establish: The defendant Li Huanqiang, dissatisfied with the victim and criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng's decision not to employ him as a driver, harbored a grudge and deliberately sought to vent his anger and retaliate. He stole and drove away the involved motor vehicle owned by Li Cheng, abandoned it after an accident, causing damage to the vehicle and theft of items inside it. Considering the dispute between Li Huanqiang and Li Cheng before the crime, the means used by Li Huanqiang to commit the crime, the fact that Li Cheng knew Li Huanqiang had not yet returned the key to the involved motor vehicle and that Li Huanqiang had previously stolen and driven away the involved motor vehicle before the incident, and in light of Li Huanqiang's own confession and other evidence in the case, it can be determined that Li Huanqiang's primary purpose was to retaliate against Li Cheng. Subjectively, he did not have the intent to unlawfully appropriate another person's property and did not have the criminal intent for theft; his act also does not meet the characteristics of the secret theft element of the crime of theft. Therefore, the crime of theft is not constituted. According to Article 12, Item (4) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in the Trial of Theft Cases, where stealing and driving away a motor vehicle causes damage to the vehicle, the actor shall be convicted and punished in accordance with Article 275 of the Criminal Law. Article 275 of the Criminal Law stipulates that whoever intentionally destroys public or private property, if the amount involved is relatively large or if there are other serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention, or a fine; if the amount involved is huge or if there are other especially serious circumstances, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years and not more than seven years. In summary, the facts and charges alleged by the prosecutorial authority are established. Li Huanqiang's act has constituted the crime of intentional destruction of property, and the amount of loss caused is relatively large. Li Huanqiang truthfully confessed to his criminal facts and showed a relatively good attitude of admission, but he had previously been subjected to criminal punishment for the crime of theft, which may be considered appropriately at sentencing.

The defendant and criminal supplementary civil action defendant Li Huanqiang caused economic losses to the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng by stealing and driving away the involved motor vehicle, and should bear criminal supplementary civil compensation liability according to law. According to Article 86 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, persons legally obligated to bear compensation in criminal supplementary civil actions include the criminal defendant, other joint wrongdoers not pursued for criminal liability, the guardians of minor criminal defendants, the heirs of executed convicts, the heirs of defendants who have died in joint crime cases before the conclusion of the trial, and other entities or individuals who should bear civil compensation liability for the criminal defendant's act according to law. Based on the facts of this case, although a vehicle custody contract relationship existed between the criminal supplementary civil action defendant, the Public Security Hongqiao Branch, and Li Cheng, this entity is not among those legally obligated to bear criminal supplementary civil compensation liability as specified in the above provision. The contractual dispute between it and Li Cheng is a different legal relationship from the criminal supplementary civil compensation liability arising from Li Huanqiang's criminal act, and this case will not address it. Li Cheng's naming of the Public Security Hongqiao Branch as a criminal supplementary civil action defendant and his claim that the Public Security Hongqiao Branch should bear joint and several liability for Li Huanqiang's criminal supplementary civil compensation liability lacks factual and legal basis and is not supported according to law.

According to Articles 1 and 2 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Scope of Criminal Supplementary Civil Actions, where a person suffers material losses due to infringement of personal rights by a criminal offense, or suffers material losses because property is destroyed by a criminal, a criminal supplementary civil action may be initiated. The material losses suffered by the victim due to the criminal act refer to the actual losses already suffered and the losses that will inevitably be suffered by the victim as a result of the criminal act. Accordingly, the scope of criminal supplementary civil compensation shall be limited to the direct economic losses suffered by the victim as a result of the criminal act. In this case, the direct economic losses suffered by the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng due to the criminal acts of the defendant and criminal supplementary civil action defendant Li Huanqiang include the value of the damage to the involved vehicle and the value of the lost in-vehicle audio-visual equipment, totaling RMB 14,683. Li Cheng's claimed losses from operating income, liquidated damages, deposits, etc., do not constitute direct economic losses suffered as a result of the criminal act, and thus his related claims are not supported. Li Cheng may file a separate civil lawsuit for these indirect economic losses.

In summary, the Tianjin Hongqiao District People's Court, in accordance with Article 275 and Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, and Article 106, Paragraph 2 of the General Principles of the Civil Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment:

1.  The defendant Li Huanqiang is guilty of the crime of intentional destruction of property and is sentenced to two years of fixed-term imprisonment.
2.  The defendant Li Huanqiang shall compensate the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng for economic losses totaling RMB 14,683.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, neither the defendant Li Huanqiang, the criminal supplementary civil action plaintiff Li Cheng, nor the criminal supplementary civil action defendant the Public Security Hongqiao Branch appealed within the statutory period, and the prosecutorial authority did not file a protest. The first-instance judgment became legally effective.
